meta.source: Chinese Cooking Demystified, '63 Chinese Cuisines: the Complete Guide' (2024)
meta.coverage: All mainland sections of the article plus Hong Kong/Macau, Taiwan and Southeast Asian Chinese. Pan-Chinese and American-Chinese are additions not in the article.
meta.notes: Dish names from the article. Aliases are menu-style spellings added for matching. weight_override marks dishes that are on nearly every US Chinese menu and are weak evidence. Markers include some well-known dishes the article doesn't list (e.g. 小笼包, 炸酱面, 羊肉串); they count weakly.
